meanings.en: to make things of the same type all have the same features or qualities
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to standardize its packaging across all markets.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket tüm pazarlarda ambalajını standartlaştırmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: unpleasantly clear, plain, or harsh in appearance
meanings.exampleEn: The report drew a stark contrast between rich and poor neighborhoods.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor zengin ve fakir mahalleler arasında keskin bir tezat ortaya koydu.

meanings.en: complete or extreme
meanings.exampleEn: He was left in stark poverty after the business failed.
meanings.exampleTr: İş batınca büsbütün yoksulluk içinde kaldı.

meanings.en: to store something safely in a hidden place
meanings.exampleEn: She stashed the money under the mattress.
meanings.exampleTr: Parayı yatağın altına sakladı.

meanings.en: a secret store of something
meanings.exampleEn: The police found a stash of stolen goods in the garage.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis garajda bir zula çalıntı mal buldu.

meanings.en: owned and controlled by the government
meanings.exampleEn: The story was broadcast on state-run television.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber devlete ait televizyonda yayınlandı.

meanings.en: a small statue
meanings.exampleEn: A bronze statuette stood on the mantelpiece.
meanings.exampleTr: Şöminenin üzerinde bronz bir heykelcik duruyordu.

meanings.en: to say nothing; to not speak or comment
meanings.exampleEn: He chose to stay silent rather than reveal his source.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaynağını açıklamaktansa sessiz kalmayı tercih etti.

meanings.en: the ability to continue doing something difficult for a long time
meanings.exampleEn: Winning a marathon requires real staying power.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir maraton kazanmak gerçek bir dayanma gücü gerektirir.

meanings.en: staying firm in belief or purpose; loyal
meanings.exampleEn: She remained steadfast in her support for the cause.
meanings.exampleTr: Davaya olan desteğinde sarsılmaz kaldı.

meanings.en: in a quiet and secret way to avoid being noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The cat moved stealthily toward the bird.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi sinsice kuşa doğru ilerledi.

meanings.en: cooked using steam rather than in water or oil
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant serves steam-cooked vegetables to keep them healthy.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran, sağlıklı kalmaları için buharda pişirilmiş sebzeler sunuyor.

meanings.tr: araya girmek, müdahale etmek, devreye girmek
meanings.en: to become involved in a difficult situation in order to help
meanings.exampleEn: When the argument got heated, the manager had to step in.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma kızıştığında müdür devreye girmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: completely clean and free from bacteria
meanings.exampleEn: Surgeons must work in a sterile environment.
meanings.exampleTr: Cerrahlar steril bir ortamda çalışmak zorundadır.

meanings.en: unable to produce offspring, plants, or results
meanings.exampleEn: The debate proved sterile and led to no new ideas.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma kısır çıktı ve hiçbir yeni fikre yol açmadı.

meanings.en: the quality of being serious and strict
meanings.exampleEn: There was a sternness in his voice that silenced the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Sesinde odayı susturan bir sertlik vardı.

meanings.en: the state of being hard to bend or move easily
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike she felt stiffness in her legs.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra bacaklarında tutukluk hissetti.

meanings.en: water that is not moving, or bottled water without gas
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like sparkling or still water?
meanings.exampleTr: Gazlı mı yoksa gazsız su mu istersiniz?

meanings.en: causing strong feelings of excitement or emotion
meanings.exampleEn: The general gave a stirring speech before the battle.
meanings.exampleTr: General savaştan önce coşturucu bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: something used temporarily until a permanent solution is found
meanings.exampleEn: The loan was only a stopgap until the company found investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredi, şirket yatırımcı bulana kadar sadece geçici bir çözümdü.

meanings.en: a traffic light, especially the red one
meanings.exampleEn: Turn left at the second stoplight.
meanings.exampleTr: İkinci trafik ışığından sola dön.

meanings.en: an occasion when work or activity stops, especially as a protest
meanings.exampleEn: The strike led to a complete stoppage of production.
meanings.exampleTr: Grev, üretimin tamamen durmasına yol açtı.

meanings.en: the act of coming to a halt or bringing something to a halt
meanings.exampleEn: There is no stopping on the highway except in emergencies.
meanings.exampleTr: Otoyolda acil durumlar dışında durmak yasaktır.

meanings.en: a piece of equipment used to store computer data
meanings.exampleEn: He copied the files onto a portable storage device.
meanings.exampleTr: Dosyaları taşınabilir bir depolama aygıtına kopyaladı.

meanings.en: rather fat or heavy and solid
meanings.exampleEn: A stout man in a grey coat blocked the doorway.
meanings.exampleTr: Gri paltolu tıknaz bir adam kapı ağzını kapatıyordu.

meanings.en: strong and thick, or brave and determined
meanings.exampleEn: They put up a stout defense against the attackers.
meanings.exampleTr: Saldırganlara karşı kararlı bir savunma yaptılar.

meanings.tr: geride kalmak, dağınık ilerlemek, arkadan sürüklenmek
meanings.en: to move or spread out in an untidy, irregular way, often falling behind
meanings.exampleEn: A few tired hikers began to straggle behind the group.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç yorgun yürüyüşçü gruptan geride kalmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a clever plan or trick to deceive an enemy or gain an advantage
meanings.exampleEn: The general used a clever stratagem to outwit his rivals.
meanings.exampleTr: General rakiplerini alt etmek için kurnaz bir taktik kullandı.

meanings.en: a long, thin line or mark of a different color
meanings.exampleEn: She had a streak of grey in her dark hair.
meanings.exampleTr: Koyu saçlarında gri bir çizgi vardı.

meanings.en: a period of continued success or failure
meanings.exampleEn: The team is on a winning streak this season.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım bu sezon galibiyet serisinde.

meanings.en: needing or using a lot of physical or mental effort
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor ona yorucu egzersizden kaçınmasını önerdi.

meanings.en: the quality of being able to stretch easily
meanings.exampleEn: The stretchiness of the fabric makes it comfortable to wear.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumaşın esnekliği onu giymeyi rahat kılıyor.

meanings.en: to scatter things over a surface or area
meanings.exampleEn: They strew flower petals along the path for the bride.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelin için yolun boyuna çiçek yaprakları serptiler.

meanings.en: angry or violent disagreement between people or groups
meanings.exampleEn: The country was torn apart by years of civil strife.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke yıllarca süren iç çatışmalarla parçalandı.

meanings.en: a person who takes off their clothes as a performance
meanings.exampleEn: The club hired a stripper for the bachelor party.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulüp bekarlığa veda partisi için bir striptizci tuttu.

meanings.en: a substance or tool used to remove paint or a coating
meanings.exampleEn: Use a paint stripper to remove the old varnish.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski cilayı çıkarmak için bir boya sökücü kullan.

meanings.en: a place that is strongly defended, or an area of strong support
meanings.exampleEn: The city was a stronghold of the rebel forces.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir isyancı güçlerin kalesiydi.

meanings.en: a room with thick walls where valuable things are kept safely
meanings.exampleEn: The bank keeps its gold in a secure strongroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Banka altınını güvenli bir kasa dairesinde saklıyor.

meanings.en: relating to the structure or framework of something
meanings.exampleEn: The building suffered serious structural damage in the earthquake.
meanings.exampleTr: Bina depremde ciddi yapısal hasar gördü.

meanings.en: lacking fresh air; hot and uncomfortable
meanings.exampleEn: Open a window; it's really stuffy in here.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir pencere aç; burası gerçekten havasız.

meanings.en: formal, boring, and old-fashioned
meanings.exampleEn: The club has a reputation for being stuffy and elitist.
meanings.exampleTr: Kulüp eski kafalı ve elitist olmakla tanınıyor.

meanings.en: quieter and less lively than usual
meanings.exampleEn: She seemed subdued after hearing the bad news.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü haberi duyduktan sonra durgun görünüyordu.

meanings.en: soft and not bright or loud
meanings.exampleEn: The room had subdued lighting that felt relaxing.
meanings.exampleTr: Odada rahatlatıcı hissettiren yumuşak bir aydınlatma vardı.

meanings.en: the act of bringing someone or something under control by force
meanings.exampleEn: The empire was built on the subjugation of neighboring peoples.
meanings.exampleTr: İmparatorluk komşu halkların boyunduruk altına alınması üzerine kuruldu.

meanings.en: the quality of being willing to obey and not resist others
meanings.exampleEn: Her submissiveness allowed others to take advantage of her.
meanings.exampleTr: İtaatkarlığı, başkalarının onu istismar etmesine izin verdi.

meanings.tr: ast konumunda olma, tabiiyet, alt sıraya koyma
meanings.en: the state of being lower in rank or of treating something as less important
meanings.exampleEn: The reform ended the subordination of women in the workplace.
meanings.exampleTr: Reform, kadınların işyerindeki ast konumuna son verdi.

meanings.tr: özlü bir şekilde, kısa ve öz olarak
meanings.en: in a way that is clearly expressed in a few words
meanings.exampleEn: She summarized the report succinctly in two sentences.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu iki cümlede özlü bir şekilde özetledi.

meanings.tr: yenik düşmek, boyun eğmek, teslim olmak
meanings.en: to lose the determination to resist something; to give in
meanings.exampleEn: He finally succumbed to the temptation and bought the car.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda cazibeye yenik düştü ve arabayı satın aldı.

meanings.en: to die from a disease or injury
meanings.exampleEn: She succumbed to her illness after a long fight.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun bir mücadelenin ardından hastalığından hayatını kaybetti.

meanings.en: a sweet-tasting substance used instead of sugar
meanings.exampleEn: She uses a sugar substitute in her coffee to cut calories.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaloriyi azaltmak için kahvesinde şeker yerine tatlandırıcı kullanıyor.

meanings.en: making you think of a particular idea or feeling
meanings.exampleEn: The symptoms are suggestive of a viral infection.
meanings.exampleTr: Belirtiler viral bir enfeksiyonu çağrıştırıyor.

meanings.en: hinting at something sexual or improper
meanings.exampleEn: He made a suggestive remark that made everyone uncomfortable.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesi rahatsız eden müstehcen bir ima yaptı.

meanings.en: the quality of being right or appropriate for a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The committee assessed each candidate's suitability for the role.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite her adayın rol için uygunluğunu değerlendirdi.

meanings.en: silent and bad-tempered because you are annoyed about something
meanings.exampleEn: The boy became sulky when he wasn't allowed to play.
meanings.exampleTr: Oynamasına izin verilmeyince çocuk somurttu.

meanings.en: having red and sore skin from being in the sun too long
meanings.exampleEn: After a day at the beach, his shoulders were badly sunburned.
meanings.exampleTr: Plajda geçen bir günün ardından omuzları fena halde güneşten yanmıştı.
